bio: Bang in the heart of the historic centre, this charmingly quaint establishment boasts a summer terrace opposite the protestant church on picturesque Temple Square. High whitewashed wooden ceilings and sandstone arches rub shoulders with light, modern fixtures in the spacious dining room. The culinary score stars tasty Gallic recipes (including a vegetarian menu) of modern inspiration crafted with first-class ingredients. The sommelier can be relied on for insightful tips and wine-tasting evenings with savvy food-wine pairings are regularly organised. The front-of-house team is professional and attentive. Booking recommended....
